origin.usage: na.locf.default(object, na.rm = TRUE, fromLast, rev, maxgap = Inf, rule = 2, ...)

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: Series, vector, or matrix. A matrix is filled down each column.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, trim leading rows that are still missing.

arguments.name: fromLast
arguments.text: Carry backward when TRUE. rev is the deprecated name.

arguments.name: rule
arguments.text: Passed to approx when x or xout is supplied.

origin.details: The default method calls na.locf0 and then na.trim when na.rm is TRUE. Supplying x or xout switches to constant interpolation.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.locf.default(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
